Looking at each problem:

**[id 180]** Winner received 3/4 of 80 votes = 60 votes. Loser received: 80 - 60 = **20**

**[id 181]** Let x = white carnations. Pink calla lilies = 200 = 5x, so x = 40. Red roses = 4x = **160**

**[id 182]** Jan is 30 now, so 2 years ago was 28. Half of 28 = 14. Mark was 14 + 5 = 19 two years ago. Mark is now 21. Jean is 2 years older than Mark: 21 + 2 = **23**

**[id 183]** Well-rounded team: 4 × 55 = 220 seconds. Less rounded: 60 + 57 + 54 + 51 = 222 seconds. Difference: 222 - 220 = **2**

**[id 184]** P(roll > 3) = 3/6 = 50%. P(two evens in a row) = (3/6)² = 25%. Difference: 50% - 25% = **25**

**[id 185]** Mom picked 20, Jenna picked 20/2 = 10. Total: 20 + 10 = **30**

**[id 186]** Straw distributed: 3r(6) + 10(5) + 20 = 160, where r = rats per cage. So 18r + 50 + 20 = 160, thus 18r = 90, r = **5**

**[id 187]** With monthly compound interest: 100 × (1.02)³ = 100 × 1.061208 = **106.12**

**[id 188]** Cost per bag: $20 + $2 = $22. Profit per bag: $30 - $22 = $8. Number of bags: $400 / $8 = **50**

**[id 189]** Tickets: $20.25. Food: $20.25 - $4.50 = $15.75. Rides: 2 × $33 = $66. Total: $102. Per person: $102 / 3 = **34**
